info.title: Cielo grande
info.synopsis: Una remota località argentina fa rivivere la sua competizione di wakeboard, attirando l'atleta messicana Steffi, determinata a svelare un segreto di famiglia.

seasons.name: Stagione 1
seasons.plot: A remote Argentine resort revives its wakeboarding competition, drawing in Mexican athlete Steffi, who is determined to uncover a family secret.

episodes.name: Episodio 1
episodes.plot: Renowned Mexican wakeboarder Steffi arrives at a remote Argentine resort to compete in a revived competition... and she's looking to uncover a secret.

episodes.name: Episodio 2
episodes.plot: A pair of famous twins arrive at Cielo Grande. Steffi finds old photos that raise new questions. Luz and her friends sing while restoring Sky Vibes.

episodes.name: Episodio 3
episodes.plot: The twins' manager threatens to leave as the staff worries about Cielo's future. Julian discusses his crush on Luz, who has eyes for someone else.

episodes.name: Episodio 4
episodes.plot: Juan attempts to win Steffi over, with Ian's help. The Cielo Grande crew makes final preparations for Sky Vibes. A new competitor joins the ranks.

episodes.name: Episodio 5
episodes.plot: Julian attempts to calm Steffi's nerves after the arrival of her rival Natasha rattles her. Luz launches Sky Vibes, but opening night hits a snag.

episodes.name: Episodio 6
episodes.plot: The identity of the girl in the photograph that Steffi found is revealed. Nati confesses she has a crush on someone. Luz and Tony go on a date.

episodes.name: Episodio 7
episodes.plot: When one of the wakeboarders is injured during training, Luz makes a startling discovery. Steffi speaks to her father about his past.

episodes.name: Episodio 8
episodes.plot: Luz and Steffi join forces to try to solve the mystery surrounding their past. Back at the resort, the crew practices a new "friend zone" song.

episodes.name: Episodio 9
episodes.plot: Steffi and Luz peel back multiple layers of deception when they confront Ron and Cynthia. Julian leads a meditation the night before the competition.

episodes.name: Episodio 10
episodes.plot: It's finally the day of the Summer Crush competition, and Natasha and Steffi face off for the trophy as their friends and family watch.

episodes.name: Episodio 11
episodes.plot: Gli amici cantano e si esibiscono nel "Save Cielo" per aiutare la località a pagare le sue bollette. Steffi ha una conversazione sincera con suo padre.

translations.value: Gli amici cantano e si esibiscono nel "Save Cielo" per aiutare la località a pagare le sue bollette. Steffi ha una conversazione sincera con suo padre.

seasons.name: Stagione 2
seasons.plot: Steffi, Luz and their family and friends fight for Cielo Grande's future after Natasha and her brother Oliver take over the resort as a power play.

episodes.name: Episodio 1
episodes.plot: Just when the resort staff thought the coast was clear, new owners want to make big changes. Steffi has doubts about competing on Natasha's terms.

episodes.name: Episodio 2
episodes.plot: Luz gets back on her wakeboard and discovers a potential new performance venue in the forest. Steffi has a lot on her mind.

episodes.name: Episodio 3
episodes.plot: Oliver discovers a new star performer. Julián shares his feelings. Luz gets serious about wakeboarding and investigates Cynthia's mysterious old flame.

episodes.name: Episodio 4
episodes.plot: Luz shares her discoveries with Julián, and Charlie hosts a crowd-pleasing show at the new theater. Santi's plan to distract Steffi might be working.

episodes.name: Episodio 5
episodes.plot: After learning about Oliver and Natasha's expansion scheme, the Cielo Grande staff acts fast to protect the heart and soul of the resort.

episodes.name: Episodio 6
episodes.plot: Natasha and Oliver consider their options after a protest interrupts their plans. Cynthia clears up some misunderstandings with Luz and Steffi.

episodes.name: Episodio 7
episodes.plot: After striking a deal with Natasha, Steffi gets back into her training groove along with Luz and Leonor before the Girls Jam competition kicks off.

episodes.name: Episodio 8
episodes.plot: The Girls Jam competitors step onto their boards for a dramatic final to settle who really rules the Waterloop — and Cielo Grande — once and for all.

translations.title: Secrets of Summer
translations.overview: A remote Argentine resort revives its wakeboarding competition, drawing in Mexican athlete Steffi, who is determined to uncover a family secret.
Un remoto resort de Argentina reinstaura una competición de wakeboarding que atrae la atención de Steffi, deportista mexicana decidida a descubrir un secreto familiar.
